pages.text: The Crafting Upgrade enables autocrafting functionality in compatible machines. When an item is needed but not available, the machine will automatically schedule a crafting task.
Features:$(li)Enables autocrafting$(li)Works in machines like Importers and Exporters$(li)Automatically schedules crafting tasks$(li)Increases power consumption

To use the Crafting Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Configure the machine's crafting settings$(li)Machine will automatically craft missing items
